Hero_Desc_KommySwim:
Kommy dressed in a swimsuit.
She has a mischievous smile.
Hopefully, she's not planning something dangerous.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_KommySwim: The boss of Furry Beach Resort!
Album_Hate_KommySwim: Unions, worker resistance, Diana's nagging, anything that disrupts the Furry Beach business.
Album_Hobby_KommySwim: Napping in a cool office while others work.
Album_Wish_KommySwim: Turning the Vacation Revolution into reality.
Album_KommySwim1: One day, Kommy suddenly appeared wearing a swimsuit. When I asked Diana about it, she sighed deeply and explained that Kommy had caused quite a commotion over at Elemental Lake. Just from Diana's reaction, I could already tell what kind of incident it was.
Album_KommySwim2: Kommy claims she doesn't wear a swimsuit because of the heat. Instead, she says it's a symbolic act to "engrave her failures into her heart." Her serious expression was so intense that I couldn't even bring myself to argue.
Album_KommySwim3: Sometimes, Kommy tries to sell a mysterious juice to people around them. Erpin panics and warns everyone never to buy or drink it. I should probably... avoid it too, right?
Album_KommySwim4: Mago flinches whenever she sees Kommy in a swimsuit. It seems like Mago had a rough experience with one of Kommy's incidents. At least Kommy apologizes every time she sees Mago.
Album_KommySwim5: On warm, sunny days, you can often find Kommy floating lazily on a tube in Elemental Lake. Watching her relax like that makes me want to grab a tube and float beside her.
Album_KommySwim6: Kommy once mentioned that if Butter handled her finances, she might actually run a decent business. Butter as an accountant? I can't quite picture it... are they just playing house or something?
Album_KommySwim7: As the weather got hotter, Kommy invited me to go swimming with her. For some reason, Erpin, who was nearby, looked like she really wanted to say something. But since it sounded like a fun idea, I just told Kommy to call me anytime.
LoveHero_KommySwim:
More fun than
a vacation?
Kommy can't wait.
LoveHeroCancel_KommySwim:
Kommy is going
to the pool.
Don't bother coming to find Kommy.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Hate1: After indulging in the joys of reality, she glared at me when I offered her virtual food. Guess I got my signals crossed.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Hate2: She got annoyed, saying eating carrots after swimming was an insult to her taste buds. Seems she still hates carrots.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like1: Claiming it's a great way to take in electrolytes, she ate ravenously, even licking the can clean.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like2: After using her brain while having fun, she said she needed something sweet and salty. She ate slowly, letting it melt in her mouth. She mostly drank it though.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like3: After a refreshing swim, she ate a warm bowl of rice cake soup and said it made her feel drowsy. She looked like she was about to fall asleep.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like4: She asked for more, saying the sweetness was perfect after swimming and that the taste of capitalism was unbeatable.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like5: Kommy was thrilled, saying a snack in the middle of swimming would give her the energy to keep playing.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like6: She mentioned that freshly steamed or even cold food was perfect for a day of swimming.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like7: Claiming it was a themed chocolate worthy of analysis, she agreed when asked if she was analyzing it in her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like8: After licking the inside of the wrapper, she said she was recharged and needed to go back to swimming. When she tried to sneak a few more, I just gave her some.
Food_ChefNote_KommySwim_Like9: Muttering something about brands, she kept grabbing more. Something about an exclusive contract, but I decided to pretend I didn't hear it.

LoveLetter_KommySwim:
Master, it is Kommy.

Kommy thought of you while swimming, so the paper may be a little wrinkled. That is fine as long as you can read it.

Do you wonder why Kommy suddenly stopped swimming to write? Kommy surpassed her limits through swimming and wondered whether you should try surpassing yours the same way.

Kommy is going swimming again now. That is all, Master.
LoveCall_KommySwim:
Hello, Master.
Kommy is resting comfortably, but felt sorry for you, since you are probably still working hard, so Kommy called.
How is that? Do you feel better? Or perhaps you envy Kommy?
It is fine. Busy times eventually end, right? When they do, come visit Kommy's playground.
Kommy will let you experience all the courses she prepared.

Ah, since you should relax while playing, be sure to wear comfortable clothes.
You may bring the others too.
...Hmm? You think Kommy plans to invite everyone and make them work again?
Ahem. K-Kommy is not such a dishonorable Werebeast. When it is time to rest, Kommy lets people rest.
Of course, if you choose to repay the inspiration of Kommy's playground with labor... Kommy will not stop you.
Anyway, understood, Master? Come play after your work is done. Kommy will rest comfortably until then.

Affinity_KommySwim_EP06_006: I can make the beach disappear too, just by closing my eyes.
Affinity_KommySwim_EP06_007: Mm-hmm! The world changes according to how you set your mind! Kommy makes the world disappear sometimes too.
Affinity_KommySwim_EP07_001: Master, why are you looking at me like that? If something is on Kommy's face, just take it off.

Affinity_KommySwim_EP07_004: Make a habit of using a napkin.
